The name Parry carries the meaning “Perseus' companion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Parry usually hope their child will grow to embody perseus' companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Parry carries a rich historical and mythological background. In ancient Greek mythology, Parry was the name of Perseus' faithful companion and assistant. This association highlights the values of companionship, loyalty, and bravery. These qualities continue to be relevant today, making the name Parry a meaningful choice for those who wish to honor these values in their personal identity.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian context, Parry can be seen as representing the faithful servant. Similar to how Perseus’ companion Parry was by his side throughout his heroic quests, Christians strive to be steadfast in their faith and loyal to God. This name embodies the concept of remaining near and staying true to God, even in the face of trials and challenges. Ultimately, the name Parry serves as a reminder of the importance of maintaining a strong spiritual foundation and unwavering commitment to God.
